title: $1 million, but no phone ever — Part 2

scenes.A: The main character standing up from a small cafe table, pushing a black briefcase back toward a mysterious man in a dark suit who smiles, warm cafe light, rain on the window.
scenes.B: The main character on a city bus tapping his phone on the fare reader, evening city lights through the windows.
scenes.C: Night street outside a closed bank with glass doors, a second cartoon man with a square tan head, dot eyes and a thin moustache, in a rumpled beige suit clutching a black briefcase and pounding on the glass in frustration, the main character watching nearby.
scenes.D: Close-up: the main character holding out his phone to a second cartoon man with a square tan head, dot eyes and a thin moustache, in a rumpled beige suit who reaches for it desperately, streetlight glow.
scenes.E: Close-up portrait of the main character facing the viewer with a calm knowing smile, holding his phone, city night behind him.
scenes.F: Far down a rainy night street, a mysterious man in a dark suit walks away carrying a black briefcase under a streetlight, seen from behind, the main character small in the foreground watching.

segments.text: You slide the briefcase back. The stranger just smiles, like he expected it.
That night your phone pays the bus, reroutes you around a closed road, and sets your alarm for work.
Two weeks later, you see the guy from the next table. He took the deal.
He's outside the bank at midnight with a million dollars he can't touch. The account needs a code. Sent to a phone.
He begs to borrow yours. Just for one code.
The second his thumb touches the screen, a text arrives.
Down the street, a man in a dark suit walks away with the briefcase.
You kept your phone. He kept nothing. The end.
